segments.text: Gumgumi dips one leg into a puddle.
But the leg looks strangely short.
The leg hasn't actually changed at all.
Let's take a closer look at the surface.
Light moves at different speeds in water and air.
Right at that boundary, the light bends slightly.
That bent light seems to come from higher up.
But our eyes always assume light travels straight.
A straw in a glass of water bends the same way.
So the leg looks shorter and lifted than it really is.
